_purpose: Pipeline-side corrections to quoted phrases whose workbook wording does not occur verbatim inside the cited locator on the live source. Each entry is a transcription correction (the source text itself), NOT a research-code, locator, or comparator change. Every override is logged in meta.json (phrase_overrides) and must be incorporated into the next controlled workbook version, after which the entry is deleted. Delete an entry to make the pipeline refuse again.
_authority: Gate 2 pipeline session, Claude Code, 2026-09-09. Author (AJP) to ratify or reject; see handoff.

overrides.workbook_value: the only begotten Son of God, Jesus Christ
overrides.override_value: Jesus Christ, the only begotten Son of God made flesh
overrides.source_reading: Lateran IV, Canon 1 (Fordham sourcebook): “And finally, Jesus Christ, the only begotten Son of God made flesh by the entire Trinity…”
overrides.reason: Workbook phrase inverts the word order; the inverted form does not occur inside Canon 1 on the cited witness.

overrides.workbook_value: Maker and Preserver of all things both visible and invisible
overrides.override_value: the Maker, and Preserver of all things both visible and invisible
overrides.source_reading: Thirty-Nine Articles, Article I (churchofengland.org): “…the Maker, and Preserver of all things both visible and invisible.”
overrides.reason: Workbook phrase omits the comma after ‘Maker’ present in the authorized text; normalization does not strip punctuation.

overrides.override_value: Creator, Redeemer, Preserver, and Ruler of the universe
overrides.source_reading: Baptist Faith and Message 2000, II. God: “…the Creator, Redeemer, Preserver, and Ruler of the universe.”
overrides.reason: ‘Creator of the universe’ is not a contiguous phrase in BF&M II; the full attribute series is.
